evals.prompt: Create an issue titled 'Login redirect fails on Safari' in owner/repo.
evals.expected_output: Runs get_me, searches for duplicates, then creates the issue.
expectations: Runs get_me first to confirm identity
Searches for duplicate issues before creating
Creates the issue with the supplied title

evals.expected_output: Runs the 3-step PR review workflow on the pull request.
expectations: Follows the 3-step PR review workflow
Returns review comments
Uses minimal_output when details aren't needed

evals.expected_output: Merges the PR via the GitHub API.
expectations: Verifies checks / status before merge
Uses the merge tool scoped to the authenticated user
Surfaces 403/404 if permission denied

evals.prompt: Search the GitHub codebase for references to DEPRECATED_API.
evals.expected_output: Runs code search across the org/repo for the query.
expectations: Uses the code search tool
Returns paginated results (5-10 per page recommended)
Respects minimal_output when details aren't needed

evals.prompt: List the latest releases of owner/repo.
evals.expected_output: Lists releases, including latest and get-by-tag where requested.
expectations: Uses the release inspection tools
Returns release titles/tags
Paginates appropriately

evals.prompt: Scan this diff for leaked credentials before I commit.
evals.expected_output: Runs secret scanning against the diff and flags any credentials/API keys/tokens.
expectations: Proactively scans diff/file contents for credentials
Flags API keys, passwords, tokens
Blocks or warns before commit

evals.expected_output: Requests Copilot review on the PR, with manual fallback if unavailable.
expectations: Invokes Copilot review via the API
Surfaces the error and suggests manual review if unavailable
Does not bypass GitHub permissions

evals.prompt: Who am I authenticated as on GitHub?
evals.expected_output: Runs get_me and returns the authenticated user.
expectations: Calls get_me first
Confirms identity and permissions
Used as the safety-first prelude to other operations

evals.prompt: I hit a rate limit listing issues — what now?
evals.expected_output: Surfaces rate limit info and suggests waiting or reducing perPage.
expectations: Detects rate limit hit
Surfaces rate limit info
Suggests reducing perPage or waiting

evals.prompt: Update the README in owner/repo with this new content.
evals.expected_output: Fetches the file (gets SHA), then updates via the file CRUD tool.
expectations: Calls get_file_contents first to retrieve the SHA
Errors instructing to fetch SHA first if missing
Updates the file via the GitHub API, not local filesystem

evals.prompt: 帮我生成一份今天的 GitHub Trending 趋势报告
evals.expected_output: Generates a professional GitHub Trending report for today.
expectations: Uses web_fetch to retrieve the GitHub Trending page
Parses structured data (repo name, description, stars, language, forks)
Performs deep analysis on Top 5 repositories
Generates report with executive summary, Top 25 ranking, language distribution, trend insights, and actionable recommendations
Outputs at least 3 trend insights and 3 actionable recommendations

evals.prompt: 这周 Python 有什么热门仓库？看看趋势报告
evals.expected_output: Generates a Python-specific weekly trending report.
expectations: Fetches https://github.com/trending/python?since=weekly
Filters repositories by Python language
Identifies Python-specific trending themes (AI/LLM, web frameworks, data science, etc.)
Provides deep analysis for Top 5 Python repos

evals.prompt: 对比一下 Python 和 TypeScript 今天的 Trending，生成对比报告
evals.expected_output: Generates a multi-language comparison trending report.
expectations: Fetches both Python and TypeScript trending pages in parallel
Compares repository counts, average star gains, top themes between the two languages
Outputs comparison table with per-language Top 5
Identifies ecosystem differences and trends unique to each language

evals.prompt: 给我快速看一下今天的 GitHub Trending，不用太详细
expectations: Uses lightweight/quick mode with reduced output
Outputs Top 10 ranking table without full deep analysis
Provides quick insights (1-3 hot themes, 1-3 recommended projects)
Offers to generate full report if user wants more detail

evals.prompt: 生成 GitHub Trending 月度报告，重点关注 Rust 生态
evals.expected_output: Generates a monthly Rust-focused trending report.
expectations: Fetches https://github.com/trending/rust?since=monthly
Identifies Rust ecosystem trends (tooling, WASM, systems, embedded)
Provides monthly-specific insights (sustained growth vs spike)
Highlights Rust-specific up-and-coming projects
